ownership_empty: No media is currently owned by anyone.
set_email_required: Add an e-mail on the Profile screen to enable notifications.
moderation_subtitle: All internal reviews — hide, show or delete any of them.
comments_empty: No reviews yet. Be the first!
report_placeholder: Describe the issue (wrong version, missing subtitles…)
report_open_intro: Tell an administrator what is wrong. They are notified right away, and you get their answer in your notifications.
error_not_configured: TMDB is not configured. Ask an administrator to set the API key in the Jelly Crowd plugin settings.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
requests_latency_disclaimer: ℹ️ Download progress and availability aren't real-time (Jellyfin isn't built for live updates), so they refresh with a delay — a title may already be playable in Jellyfin before its request here is marked Available.
announcement_placeholder: Announcement shown to all users (leave empty to clear)
notif_categories: Email/ntfy me for (in-app alerts stay on):
notif_cat_unreleased: A title I requested before release becomes available
notif_cat_decisions: My requests are approved, denied or fail
reviews_none: No internal reviews yet — be the first.
no_media: You have no available media yet.
claim_quota_warning: This already-available title will be added to your library and counts toward your quota.
claim_quota_blocked: Quota full — free some space in your library before adding this title.
renew_quota_blocked: Quota exceeded — free some space in your library before you can renew.
status_held_hint: Held because you've reached your storage quota — it resumes automatically once you free some space.
status_held_hint_admin: Held by the requester's storage quota, not awaiting you — it resumes automatically when their space frees up. You can still approve it now.
admin_retry_all_msg: Re-trigger a search for every approved request that isn't available yet (stuck, blocked or errored)?
confirm_delete_media: Delete this media and its files? It is removed after the retention period (cancellable until then), and the download backend is purged.
admin_create_hint: To request on behalf of a user, open a title in the catalog and use the admin "Request on behalf of" selector.
quota_full_hint: Quota exceeded — delete some media to free space before requesting more.
quota_probation_hint: You earned extra storage but have been inactive — watch something to keep it, otherwise it returns to the standard quota.
admin_quota_hint: Leave empty to use the default quota. 0 means unlimited.
branding_intro: Customise the look of the whole Jellyfin interface for every user. Changes apply live.
branding_enabled_hint: Master switch. When off, Jellyfin's default appearance is left untouched.
branding_avatar_hint: Shown for users without their own photo (best-effort overlay).
branding_font_url_hint: Optional — e.g. a Google Fonts URL, imported before the font is used.
branding_drawer_hint: Custom links added to Jellyfin's left navigation drawer.
stats_empty: No activity in this period yet.
stats_nobody: No one is watching right now.
stats_import_hint: One-time backfill of viewing history recorded before Jelly Crowd (from the Playback Reporting plugin's database). Safe to re-run.
stats_import_confirm: Import historical playback from the Playback Reporting plugin? Existing statistics are kept; only plays from before Jelly Crowd started are added.
adm_before_the_first_episode_of_a: Before the first episode of a series (S01E01)
adm_comma_separated_tmdb_genre_names_whe: Comma-separated TMDB genre names. When set, the size rule above only auto-approves a title with at least one of these genres. Empty = all genres. Trusted users always bypass.
adm_confirm_delete_disk: Delete "{title}" from disk? This is permanent.
adm_drop_video_s_in_a_folder_hint: Drop video(s) in a folder with the name below beside your media libraries; the plugin finds and indexes it. On the web client the pre-roll is non-skippable with hidden controls.
adm_elevate_active_users_above_and_decay: Elevate active users above, and decay inactive users below, their base quota.
adm_native_mobile_and_tv_apps_can_hint: Native mobile and TV apps can fail to start playback when a pre-roll is prepended (reported on iPad). When on, only the web client and Jellyfin Media Player receive intros.
adm_show_discord_icon_in_the_header: Show Discord icon in the header
adm_show_support_donation_icon_in_the: Show support / donation icon in the header
adm_show_user_guide_icon_in_the: Show user-guide icon (?) in the header
cfg_allowuserretrysearch: Let users retry the search themselves
cfg_hiddenfromusers: Config mode — hide the plugin from regular users
cfg_hiddenfromusers_hint: Hide Jelly Crowd from non-admins until it is configured and working. Admins are unaffected.
cfg_language_hint: Language of the Jelly Crowd user pages and notifications.
cfg_partialavailabilitygracehours_hint: A season or whole-series request is marked available once every aired episode is in the library. If some episodes are there but none has arrived for this long, it is marked available with what it has, so a missing episode cannot keep it pending forever.
cfg_ratelimitgetperminute_hint: Generous cap so a scripted loop cannot hammer the TMDB-backed catalog. 0 disables it.
cfg_removeemptyseries: Remove empty series left after deletion
cfg_media_types_hint: Turn off one to run a movies-only or series-only instance. At least one stays on.
cfg_request_granularity_hint: TV only — how finely users can request shows. At least one stays on.
cfg_at_least_one: At least one option must stay selected.
cfg_segmenthwaccel_hint: Offloads the end-credits video decode to the GPU during the Media Segment Scan — the heavy part. Auto falls back to CPU when no GPU decoder is available. (The Skip Intro fingerprint is audio-only, so it is unaffected.)
cfg_segmentminseasoncoverage_hint: A real title or credits sequence recurs across a season. When fewer than this share of a season's episodes share the detected sequence, it is discarded as a coincidence rather than served as a skip button in the middle of a scene. 0 disables the check.
cfg_showreviewauthors: Show review author names to everyone
cfg_reportnotifybell: Alert every administrator in their bell
cfg_reportnotifybell_hint: Works with nothing else configured — the alert appears in the 🔔 panel of each administrator.
cfg_reportnotifyotherchannels: Notify the other channels (Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, Slack, webhook)
cfg_reportreminderdays_hint: 0 disables reminders. One recap covers every report waiting longer than this, so a backlog cannot flood you.
bulk_failed: {failed} of {total} did not go through. You can try again.
prefs_enabled_hint: Turn everything below off at once. The bell in the header keeps working either way.
prefs_email_hint: Leave blank to receive nothing by e-mail.
prefs_ntfy_hint: A topic on the ntfy server your admin configured. Leave blank to skip ntfy.
prefs_send_test: Save and send me a test
prefs_categories_hint: What you want to hear about. These apply to e-mail and ntfy; the bell always shows everything.
prefs_email_invalid: That does not look like an e-mail address.
prefs_test_sent: Test sent. It should arrive within a minute.
prefs_test_failed: The test could not be delivered. Check the address, or ask your admin whether e-mail is set up on the server.
notif_created_body: A new {kind} request is pending approval: {title}.
notif_available_body: "{title}" is now available in the library.
notif_failed_body: The {kind} request "{title}" could not be fulfilled yet (no release found or a backend error). You can retry the search.
notif_batch_body: {n} episodes of "{title}" are now available in the library (episodes {episodes}).
notif_test_body: This is a test notification from Jelly Crowd. If you can read this, the channel works.
notif_test_personal: This is a test from Jelly Crowd. If you can read this, your notifications reach you.
notif_email_footer: Sent by Jelly Crowd, the request system on your Jellyfin server.
notif_report_reminder_body: {n} report(s) are still waiting — the oldest, {subject}, for {days} day(s).
notif_report_resolved_body: Your report on "{title}" has been resolved.
notif_report_resolved_body_note: Your report on "{title}" has been resolved. Admin note: {note}
notif_quota_held_available_body: "{title}" is now available to download, but you have reached your storage quota, so it is on hold. Free space (let some media expire, or request its deletion) and it will resume automatically.
notif_quota_held_request_body: Your request "{title}" is on hold because you have reached your storage quota. Free space (let some media expire, or request its deletion) and it will resume, or an admin can review it.
notif_notfound_subject: Not found — we couldn't get it
notif_notfound_body: We searched for "{title}" for two weeks and no source turned up, so we have stopped looking. It does not count against your quota. Ask an admin if you would like them to try again or find it another way.
notif_expired_body: "{title}" has left your library after {days} days (your quota is freed). Re-add it from the catalog if you still want it.
notif_adaptive_promoted_body: Thanks for watching — your storage quota has been increased. Keep it up to keep the bonus.
notif_adaptive_probation_subject: Your bonus storage is under review
notif_adaptive_probation_body: You've been away for a while, so your extra storage is on hold. Watch something soon to keep it — otherwise it returns to the standard quota.
notif_adaptive_restored_body: Welcome back! Your extra storage is active again.
notif_adaptive_standard_body: Your bonus storage has returned to the standard quota after a period of inactivity. Stay active to earn it back.
history_hidden: Your history is hidden. Recording continues for the server statistics.
history_clear_confirm: Erase your entire viewing history? This cannot be undone.
notif_assigned_body: "{title}" was added to your library by an administrator.
assign_media_subtitle: Give a user ownership of a title already in the library — e.g. something you added by hand that nobody requested.
adm_bulk_applied: Applied to {n} user(s) — remember to Save.
adm_groups_hint: Groups let you manage several users at once: members inherit the group's Jelly Crowd settings (a per-user override still wins), and you can push the group's libraries onto their Jellyfin accounts. A user belongs to one group.
adm_groups_empty: No groups yet. Create one to manage users together.
adm_group_apply_msg: This sets each member's Jellyfin libraries to exactly the ones ticked above (nothing else). Continue?
adm_group_apply_done: Library access applied to {applied}/{total} member(s) — {libs} library(ies).
adm_group_delete_msg: Delete the group "{name}"? Members keep their accounts and any per-user overrides; they simply stop inheriting this group.
adm_hide_drawer: Hide the Jellyfin side menu for non-admins
adm_hide_drawer_hint: Hides the left hamburger drawer for regular users; administrators keep it.
